title: Ethics, Rules of Engagement, and AI: Neural Narrative Mapping Using Large Transformer Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using iterative prompting of GPT-3 to generate Neural Narrative Maps (NNMs) and force-directed graph layouts to visualize spatial relationships and trajectories between lawful concepts (e.g., careful, ethical) and lawless concepts in military decision-making.

Visualizing the proximity and strong association of 'masculine' textual concepts to 'lawless' and 'kill the enemy' nodes within the language model's mapped narrative space to evaluate how such biases affect simulated decision-making.
